name: cmux.hovercard/1
docs: The hover card of a sidebar row. The render export gets the hovered row as ctx.target ({kind: "workspace", id}) and returns the card's view; a failed render shows its error on the built-in card. Honored from the user's own local/customize app only, which also gets ctx.card (the built-in card's fields).

targets.description: The rows whose card this app draws; workspace rows by default.

status: draft: shapes are refined with the first implementing app before the interface is public
